Container capture (not hardware): `openwrt/rootfs:aarch64_generic-25.12.6` (privileged, OrbStack kernel 7.2), 2026-11-20, #277. `apk add mwan3` installed `mwan3-2.12.0-r3` with `iptables-nft 1.8.10`, the package and versions of the AXT1800 (issue #277). The router was not touched.

Setup: `ubusd` and `netifd` started by hand; `/etc/config/network` has `wwan` (veth `v1`, 192.0.2.2/24, gw 192.0.2.1) and `usbtether` (veth `v2`, 198.51.100.2/24, gw 198.51.100.1, metric 20), each veth peer in its own netns that holds 1.1.1.1 and 8.8.8.8 on `lo` and answers ping. `/etc/config/mwan3` is `config-mwan3.txt`: exactly `failover.Desired` for uplinks wwan, usbtether (a `globals` section with the stock `mmx_mask` added). mwan3 was started with the body of `start_service` of `/etc/init.d/mwan3` sourced from `/lib/mwan3/mwan3.sh` (no procd in the container) and `/usr/sbin/mwan3track wwan` / `usbtether` run in the background.

- interfaces-online.txt: `mwan3 interfaces` with both uplinks answering. Verbatim.
- mangle-online.txt: `iptables -t mangle -S` at the same time. The kernel lacks `xt_CONNMARK` (the AXT1800 has it via `kmod-ipt-conntrack-extra`), so iptables printed `Warning: Extension CONNMARK is not supported, missing kernel module?` on stderr; that line is dropped, stdout is verbatim.
- interfaces-wwan-offline.txt, mangle-wwan-offline.txt: the same ~40 s after an nft `input` drop in the `wwan` peer netns (mwan3track: `disconnecting`, then `offline`; the policy chain switched to `usbtether`). The mangle table had been saved and restored once with `iptables-save`/`iptables-restore -T mangle` before this capture. Same stderr line dropped.
- interfaces-tracking-disabled.txt: `mwan3 interfaces` after `uci delete mwan3.usbtether.track_ip; uci commit mwan3` and removing `/var/run/mwan3track/usbtether`: the "unknown and tracking is disabled" line the AXT1800 showed before #277. Verbatim.
- mangle-native-rule.txt: `nft add chain ip mangle ts-probe; nft add rule ip mangle ts-probe ct mark set meta mark and 0xff0000` (a native `ct mark` rule, the shape Tailscale's nftables mode writes), then `iptables -t mangle -S; echo "exit $?"` (stderr included). Verbatim.
- create-policy-native-rule.txt: with that rule present, `mwan3_create_policies_iptables travo_failover` from `/lib/mwan3/mwan3.sh` (after `mwan3_init; config_load mwan3`, with `LOG` echoing to stderr), stdout and stderr. mwan3 reads its own state with `iptables -t mangle -S`; the failed read looks like an empty table, so it re-creates an existing chain and the whole `iptables-restore` batch is refused. Verbatim.
